about: MeeMee Station's own lines. Everything else it says is MeeMee Rescue's (shared by their own ids): the numbers (num-mid-*, num-end-*), and, make, q-lets-make, q-weve-got, q-how-many-more, q-how-many-altogether, q-count-on-from, praise-found-it, praise-thats-right, praise-super-counting, praise-well-done, again-try-again, again-count-with-me, too-many and tap-scruffles. A new line is "pending" until Barney has recorded it: it shows on the recording page, and the game leaves it out until then.

lines.how: Friendly and clear, like showing someone a new game.
